com.sun.tools.javadoc.api

类 JavadocTaskImpl

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.tools.javadoc.api.JavadocTaskImpl
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Callable<Boolean>, DocumentationTool.DocumentationTask

    public class JavadocTaskImpl
extends Object
implements DocumentationTool.DocumentationTask
    Provides access to functionality specific to the JDK documentation tool, javadoc.

    This is NOT part of any supported API. If you write code that depends on this, you do so at your own risk. This code and its internal interfaces are subject to change or deletion without notice.

      • call

        public Boolean call()
        从接口复制的说明: DocumentationTool.DocumentationTask
        Performs this documentation task. The task may only be performed once. Subsequent calls to this method throw IllegalStateException.
        指定者:
        call 在接口中 Callable<Boolean>
        指定者:

        返回:
        true if and only all the files were processed without errors; false otherwise
